claims.claim: It's an open wardrobe, can be used at home or boutique
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an open-face wooden shelving/wardrobe unit with compartments and a hanging rail, consistent with this description.
No purchase receipt, date stamp, or comparative wear photo available.
Room is dim and cluttered with loose clothing on the floor; no clear, lit close-up of the wood surface or rail fabric parts exists.
Witness identifies this as a wooden shelving/wardrobe unit with compartments and a hanging rail — no foam component is described or visible anywhere in the photo.

risks.risk: Description mismatch: 'foam still firm' suggests the seller's text may belong to a different item (e.g., a mattress or sofa ad), raising doubt about whether the photo and words describe the same listing.
risks.proof: A fresh, dated photo/video of the actual wardrobe with the seller visibly present, or a live video call showing the unit from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Treated as a high-risk/possible mismatched listing; priced at worst case or flagged rather than priced until identity is reconciled.

risks.risk: Unknown structural integrity and wood quality (scratches, warping, weak joints).
risks.proof: Close-up shots of joints, shelf undersides, and the hanging rail bracket.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case, i.e. assume visible wear and possible instability.

risks.risk: Unclear whether the folded clothes and hanging garments are included in the sale or just the furniture.
risks.proof: Seller's explicit written confirmation plus a photo of the empty unit.
Photo with a tape measure or known-size object beside the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the smallest common size for this style of unit.

risks.risk: Hanging rail or compartment dividers may be damaged or loose, not visible due to clutter.
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit photos of the rail attachment points and each compartment divider.

proof_requests: A live video call or fresh timestamped photos clearly showing the whole wardrobe without clutter.
Close-up shots of the wood joints, hanging rail brackets, and compartment interiors.
A photo with a measuring tape to confirm dimensions.
Explicit confirmation on whether clothes are included in the sale.
Clarification from the seller on the 'foam' comment, since no foam part is visible on this item.
response.reason: The seller's claim about 'foam still firm' does not match the witnessed wooden wardrobe/shelving unit, suggesting a possible copy-pasted or mismatched description that warrants caution before any price is set.
